decision.supportedWindowsPolicy: Windows 11 x64 releases still in Microsoft servicing; 24H2 is the current floor and 25H2 is the primary QA target

environment.cpu: Intel Core i7-14700HX, 20 cores, 28 logical processors

tauri2.runtime: Rust host with system Edge WebView2

accessibility.probe: Windows UI Automation over the WRY child window with deterministic renderer accessibility enabled
accessibility.structure: Document, headings/text, labeled edit, buttons and groups were exposed

tray.implementation: First-party Tauri tray/menu APIs plus close interception

tauri2.build: Frontend, cargo check, optimized release and NSIS bundle passed

winui3.runtime: C# WinUI 3, unpackaged and self-contained for runtime probes

accessibility.probe: Windows UI Automation over the main window
accessibility.structure: Native edit, button, progress bar and expander patterns were exposed

winui3.build: Unpackaged release and unsigned self-contained MSIX passed; symbols package was skipped because mspdbcmf.exe was unavailable
winui3.packagedLaunch: Not run: the development package correctly refused to register while Windows Developer Mode was disabled

method.startup: Five sequential launches per candidate, from process start until Windows UI Automation could find the Add download button
method.memory: Process-tree sums two seconds after launch; working-set sums can double-count shared pages, while private bytes are committed private memory rather than unique RSS
method.tray: WM_CLOSE was sent to the visible top-level window; the process had to remain alive and the original window had to become invisible
method.installer: Artifacts were built but not installed; no certificate trust, Developer Mode or global SDK configuration was changed

limitations: One Windows 11 x64 machine; no ARM64 or virtual-machine coverage
The small journey is representative, not the production queue or Rust-core integration
Narrator, Accessibility Insights, contrast themes, 200 percent scaling and reduced-motion behavior still require release QA
Startup and memory numbers are comparative local measurements, not product guarantees
